spec: DESIGN.md — Vocabulary; issue #784 D2, D5, D18. Hand judgements applied by the loader over platform_table.json: 'merge' says two generated rows are one system, a map ('source', 'key', 'rows') replaces one key's row set (relation null, narrowMatch or relatedMatch), 'row_of' states a row's kind. Every entry anchors on (source, key) pairs the sources have at their pins, never on a row name, and carries a reason; the loader cites it by its anchors' own citations, and 'citation' holds only the evidence the entry adds beyond them (null when it adds none).
